camel_example: aliyun outboundbot MakePilotCall --region cn-hangzhou --DraftVersion false --VerificationCode 123456 --Number 13800000000 --InstanceId 'instance-example-001' --DeviceId 10001 --ScriptId 'script-example-001' --version 2025-11-11 --method POST --force
kebab_example: aliyun outboundbot make-pilot-call --instance-id instance-example-001 --script-id script-example-001 --number 13800000000 --draft-version false --verification-code 123456 --device-id 10001 --api-version 2025-11-11 --region cn-hangzhou
name: MakePilotCall

parameters.help_en: The instance identity of the product. You must use an instance that the invoker has access to and that actually exists. The instance must be consistent with the instance to which the scenario, channel, and session belong. The maximum length is subject to the current POP parameter definition
parameters.help_zh: 所属产品的实例标识。必须使用调用者有权访问且确实存在的实例；应与场景、渠道和会话所属实例保持一致。最大长度以当前POP参数定义为准
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The dialog scenario ID of the instance. Specify an existing scenario. Subsequent dialog and end requests for the same text session must use the scenario specified when the session is started
parameters.help_zh: 实例下的对话场景标识。请填写实际存在的场景；同一文本会话的后续对话和结束请求应使用开启会话时的场景
parameters.name: script_id

parameters.help_en: The called phone number for the current real-number outbound call test. The number must be the same as the one used to obtain the SMS verification code. Specify a number that is actually supported by the business and authorized. The current request object only requires this parameter to be non-empty. This document does not fabricate number formats or international number support scopes
parameters.help_zh: 本次真实号码外呼测试的被叫电话号码，应与获取短信验证码时使用的号码一致。填写业务实际支持且已获授权的号码；当前请求对象仅声明非空，不在本次文档中虚构号码格式或国际号码支持范围
parameters.name: number

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to use the draft version. Valid values:
true: Uses the draft version.
false: Uses the published version.
This parameter does not publish the scenario. Ensure that the selected scenario version exists before you call this operation
parameters.help_zh: 场景版本选择：true使用草稿版本，false使用发布版本。不是场景发布操作；调用前需确保所选场景版本存在
parameters.name: draft_version

parameters.help_en: The SMS verification code sent to the number specified by Number for the verification of the OutboundCallTest scenario. The request must use a valid verification code actually received by the number. The example only demonstrates a string parameter and cannot be used to pass the verification. It also does not declare undefined length rules for the code
parameters.help_zh: 发送到Number对应号码、用于OutboundCallTest场景校验的短信验证码。请求必须使用该号码实际收到且仍有效的验证码；示例仅演示字符串参数，不能用于通过验证，也不声明代码未定义的长度规则
parameters.name: verification_code

parameters.help_en: The ID of the client device that initiates the web voice or receives data channel events. The same client must use the same DeviceId when obtaining data channel credentials and initiating a call. The example is only a business device ID and not a real credential assigned by the platform
parameters.help_zh: 标识发起网页语音或接收数据通道事件的客户端设备。同一客户端获取数据通道凭证和发起呼叫时应使用相同的DeviceId；示例仅为业务设备标识，不是平台分配的真实凭证
parameters.name: device_id

parameters.help_en: The attached data string passed to the call link. Use the key=value format. Separate multiple key-value pairs with semicolons. Do not use JSON. For example, the Callee key can be used by the web call service to read the called party information. The example number is a placeholder value. Specify the actual value based on the access conventions of your business. Do not overwrite internal tags that do not belong to the business custom scope
parameters.help_zh: 传递给呼叫链路的随路数据字符串，使用key=value形式，多个键值对以分号分隔，不是JSON。例如Callee键可供网页呼叫服务读取被叫信息；示例号码为占位值，实际业务需按接入约定填写。不要覆盖不属于业务自定义范围的内部标记
parameters.name: tags

parameters.help_en: The variables passed to the phone call link. The value is a JSON object string, and variable values are processed as strings. Specific variable names are agreed upon by the call link and business scenario. This parameter is not semicolon-separated Tags. The example uses an empty object when no custom variables are defined
parameters.help_zh: 传递到电话呼叫链路的变量，为JSON对象字符串，变量值按字符串处理。具体变量名称由呼叫链路和业务场景约定，不是分号分隔的Tags；没有自定义变量时示例使用空对象
parameters.name: call_variables

schema.description_en: The business response of this API operation. Code=OK indicates success, and Data contains the corresponding business result. For business errors, troubleshoot the issue based on Message and Params
schema.description_zh: 本次API的业务响应，Code=OK表示成功，Data为对应业务结果；业务错误结合Message及Params排查

Code.description_en: The business processing status code. OK indicates success. When an exception occurs, the corresponding business error code is returned. Error types and mapping rules follow the current API configuration. No error codes are added or modified in this operation
Code.description_zh: 业务处理状态码，OK表示成功；发生异常时返回对应的业务错误码。错误类型和映射规则沿用当前API配置，本次不新增或修改错误码

Data.description_en: The session ID of the current real-number outbound call test. The return of this object does not indicate that the called party has answered
Data.description_zh: 本次真实号码外呼测试的会话标识。返回该对象并不意味着被叫已接听

SessionId.description_en: The session ID used to uniquely associate the current interaction. For a text session, it is the text- ID returned when the session is started. For web voice, it is the ws- ID. For a real-number outbound call test, it is the test- ID. Subsequent calls must use the actual return value
SessionId.description_zh: 用于唯一关联本次交互的会话标识。文本会话为开启会话返回的text-标识，网页语音为ws-标识，真实号码外呼测试为test-标识；后续调用必须使用实际返回值

HttpStatusCode.description_en: The HTTP status code recorded in the business response body. A normal return value is 200. To determine whether the business operation is successful, you must also check Code. You cannot determine the success of the call solely based on the presence of this field
HttpStatusCode.description_zh: 业务响应体记录的HTTP状态码，正常返回为200。判断业务是否成功还应检查Code，不能仅凭该字段存在认定调用成功

Message.description_en: The business response or error description. This field is usually empty or not returned upon success. A fixed text cannot be required upon success. Upon failure, this field contains an error description to assist in troubleshooting. Combine this field with Code and Params to understand the cause of the error. The example shows an error message when the instance does not exist, where Code is NotExists.InstanceId. This is for format reference only
Message.description_zh: 业务响应或错误说明。成功时通常为空或不返回，不能要求成功时固定返回某段文本；失败时为错误说明，用于辅助排查，并结合Code与Params理解错误原因。示例为实例不存在时的错误消息（对应Code为NotExists.InstanceId），仅作格式参考

Params.description_en: The list of parameters used for the localized display of error messages. This is not a scenario variable or business result. A normal successful response usually returns an empty array. When an error occurs, parameters corresponding to the error template may be returned
Params.description_zh: 用于错误消息本地化展示的参数列表，不是场景变量或业务结果。正常成功响应通常为空数组；出现错误时可能返回与错误模板对应的参数

items.description_en: A parameter value in the error message template. The specific content is determined by the current error. The example InstanceId only demonstrates a possible field name and does not indicate that this value is returned in every call
items.description_zh: 错误消息模板中的一个参数值。具体内容由本次错误决定；示例InstanceId仅演示可能的字段名，不表示每次调用均返回该值

RequestId.description_en: The ID used to associate and troubleshoot the current POP request. The value in the response corresponds to the current request. System request parameters are injected by the gateway. Callers do not need to fill in system fields
RequestId.description_zh: 用于关联和排查本次POP请求的标识。响应中的值对应本次请求；系统请求参数由网关注入，调用者不需要自行填写系统字段
